name: Dublin (Ireland)
description: A green field with a blue canton bearing three white castles in flames, and a gold harp in the fly.
history: Dublin's flag dates from 1885: a green field with the gold harp of Ireland and the three burning castles of the thirteenth-century city seal in the canton. The canton was later enlarged, pushing the harp toward the fly. It is the only flag flown by the city.

features.role: three burning castles from the city seal
features.symbolism: the zeal of the citizens in the city's defence
